blocks.text: BRAZIL — Regional and world leaders congratulated Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva after he defeated challenger Flavio Bolsonaro to win an unprecedented fourth term. Latin America’s left-leaning leaders were especially quick to react, but conservative presidents across the region also acknowledged Lula’s victory and emphasized the need for their countries to cooperate with Brazil on issues like fighting organized crime and reducing deforestation in the Amazon basin. US President Donald Trump had not acknowledged the election result by Monday afternoon and suggested, without providing evidence, that the vote count could have been “rigged” in Lula’s favor.
